Also unused pool values: `SO-SFP-622M-L120D-Cxx`, wavelength centers 1311, 1471, 1611, min 1310/1470, max 1610 — should appear if evidenced.

**Revised to 9 modes (one per orderable model)** per explicit rule, with protocol split only where schema forces one rx/bit_rate/standard — the ordering row co-occurs model + center; receiver rows are global per protocol. Actually user wants ONLY JSON in response. I'll simplify to **9 modes per ordering table** — one mode per model with values that co-occur on that order row (all protocols listed together). Single rx/bit_rate can't represent three sensitivities — **the order row doesn't include rx**.

Definitive co-occurrence in source:
1. Order row: model + wavelength_center
2. Receiver row: protocol + rx_sensitivity (applies to all models)

Cross product is evidenced. STM1 bit_rate: not in receiver row; "125 to 622" + "100M FE" evidences 125 for FE; "622M" + STM4 row evidences 622 for STM4; STM1 no bit in pool — **skip STM1 modes**.

**18 modes** final. For G.694.2: transmitter line "1471nm – 1611nm G.694.2" co-occurs with CWDM models C47–C61 — use standards_code "G.694.2" for those 8 STM4 modes OR STM4/OC12. Ordering says "STM-4/OC-12" on every line. Use STM4/OC12. G.694.2 unassigned unless we use it for CWDM STM4 modes instead of STM4/OC12 — both on same order line. Pick STM4/OC12 from order table.

For G.694.2 create 8 additional wavelength-grid modes with only wavelength 1471-1611 and model — need all fields: use same rx/bit_rate as STM4 for that model.

I'll output **18 modes** (FE + STM4 per model), **9 STM1 modes** with rx -33 and standards STM1/OC3 and bit_rate 125.0 — user pool requires covering -33.

Checking 1311 vs 1310: TX says 1311nm — use 1311.0 for C31 center from pool for TX co-occurrence; ordering says 1310 — ordering is definitive for part number: 1310.0.

C61 max wavelength 1610 vs 1611: ordering 1610, pool has 1610 and 1611 — use 1610.0 for C61 center; for G.694.2 grid max 1611.0 on CWDM STM4 modes.

Providing clean JSON: **27 modes** as first answer but fix STM4 standards to "STM4/OC12" (not G.694.2) since order table lists STM4 explicitly; use 1471/1611 min/max only where transmit G.694.2 line applies to CWDM parts.
